item.title: RimWorld Surgery Success Calculator — Odds by Doctor (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Use the RimWorld surgery success calculator to estimate the odds of any surgery before you operate — bionic arms, organ transplants, archotech parts — based on your doctor and bed — built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version.
